[font=Arial][b][size=6][color=#b4a7d6]Gothic[/color] Seasonal Garage & Tractor
[/size]
Mod Name[/b]: [CP] Gothic Seasonal Garage & Tractor
[b]Version[/b]: 1.5.0
[b]Author[/b]: Pokegirl Gamer
[b]Description[/b]: This mod replaces the original assets of Pathoschild's Tractormod to match with the new and most accurate gothic texture for Idalda's Goth Buildings.
[b]Required Mods[/b]: Pathoschild.ContentPatcher, Pathoschild.TractorMod, & Idalda's Goth Buildings
[b]Mod Compatibility[/b]: Windows & Android
[b]Credits To[/b]: Pokegirl Gamer.
 
[b][size=6]Installation [color=#b4a7d6]Guide[/color][/size][/b]

How to load Gothic Seasonal Garage & Tractor?
[b]Android users[/b]
1. Download the file "[/font][font=Arial][b][color=#b4a7d6][CP] Gothic Seasonal Garage & Tractor[/color][/b][/font][font=Arial]".
2. Must download [b][color=#d9ead3]Zarchiver[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip[/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Paste the Mod file into the Mods folder “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardewvalley[/color][/b][b]”[/b].
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] Installer and launch the app to load the CPGSGT mod. Enjoy..
[b] [/b]
[b]Windows users[/b]
1. Download the file "[color=#f4cccc][font=Arial][b][color=#b4a7d6][CP] Gothic Seasonal Garage & Tractor[/color][/b][/font][/color]".
2. Must download [b][color=#ea9999]Winrar[/color][/b] or any types of [b]Zip [/b]/ [b]7z Extractor[/b].
3. Click Extract to get the files
4. Copy and paste the mod file into your “[b][color=#fff2cc]Stardew Valley[/color][/b][b]”[/b] folder.
5. Click your [b]SMAPI[/b] exe to load the [font=Arial]CPGSGT[/font] mod. Enjoy..
 
[b]Reminder: I [Pokegirl Gamer] is the owner of these assets, I tried matching my assets to Idadal's Goth Buildings mod and thankfully it matched. Please do not use them without my consent. Glitches or Errors? Please report all of the bugs and join
my discord server as well to contact me directly.[/b]
 
[b][size=5]The [color=#ff0000]Problems[/color] that you'll might encounter[/size][/b]
So far, there are no bugs have found on the Content Patcher [font=Arial]CPGSGT[/font] version yet
but please let me know by joining my discord server.
